description: Production of Natural Gas Liquids is a dataset listed in Artificial Intelligence Global Company - ODS open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by United Nations Statistics Division. This dataset contains Production of Natural Gas Liquids -by end use from 1990-2022. Data from United Nations Statistics Division. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Notes: - Refer back to the original source for numbers estimated by the United Nations Statistics Division (numbers with symbol). Coverage: Gulf Cooperation Council states. The portal files it under Oil & gas. Its keywords are LPG, Naphtha, Ethane, End-use products, Gas, Refinery gas. The portal shows 12,009 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-aigc-portal.
